lines: Douglas has seen more work lately: 7.3 targets per game over his last 3, up from 5.8 on the season, a 28% target share.
He played 81% of snaps over his last 3 games. He scored 10.5 PPR points per game in that stretch, against 11.8 on the season.
Week 11 is at BUF, which allows the 10th-most PPR points to WRs. The coach said Douglas will be a bigger part of the passing offense.
